text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived.
The final episode of UGE.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: ...Finally, huh.
choice_data_list: Yes. The time has finally come, hasn't it...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
At first, this body felt like a borrowed vessel.
But now...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
To each and every circuit, down to every single pipe
...my will flows through them all.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Being able to make it this far is entirely thanks to...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Professor, now that we've made it this far... we're safe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"You can definitely go further.
Beyond even the place you yearned for."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I went through harsh training as well.
It is not just ST-2 that has evolved.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Mecha Umamusume are all you have left, right, Professor?
Then... show me how much they mean to you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A tin can? Where do you see such a thing?
Towering before your eyes is
a demigod vessel harboring divine blood.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I've dumped all the sauce in and tuned it myself. I've got nothing left to say.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone...
Thank you...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: The me of today is... the culmination of all of us.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've been a great help as well.
Managing such an eccentric bunch...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you pulling everything together, we managed to pull through.
Um... I don't even know how to thank you...
choice_data_list: No, it's... still too early for thanks.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. How fast I can run in this final test...
Repaying their kindness means showing it through my results.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look at me.
Look at ST-2.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: I will show everyone my brightest shine yet, without fail!

<chrname> is going almost all out this time.
There won't be any holding back.

"The culmination of all wisdom.
Can Mecha Umamusume ST-2 truly reach
the heights of a flesh-and-blood Umamusume?"
